tasks.title: Fix Minecraft 1.21.7 Compatibility Issues in FakePlayer Implementation
tasks.description: Resolve critical errors in the FakePlayer class caused by Minecraft 1.21.7 internal changes to packet systems and entity data structures, preventing player disconnections.
tasks.details:
Implement comprehensive compatibility fixes for Minecraft 1.21.7:

1. Update ProtocolLib dependency:
   - Verify and update to the latest ProtocolLib version compatible with 1.21.7
   - Modify dependency declaration in plugin.yml and pom.xml/build.gradle
   - Update DependencyManager to check for the correct ProtocolLib version

2. Refactor FakePlayer class to accommodate new packet structure:
   - Fix `FieldAccessException: Field index 0 is out of bounds for length 0` by updating field access methods
   - Replace deprecated NAMED_ENTITY_SPAWN packet references with SPAWN_ENTITY
   - Create adapter pattern to handle packet type differences between versions
   - Implement version detection to apply appropriate packet handling

3. Update entity data handling:
   - Refactor code using SynchedEntityData to match new class structure
   - Replace DataItem casting with appropriate DataValue implementation
   - Create abstraction layer for entity metadata to handle version differences
   - Implement proper type checking before casting operations

4. Implement robust error handling:
   - Add try-catch blocks around critical packet operations
   - Create detailed logging for packet-related errors
   - Implement graceful degradation when packet operations fail
   - Add telemetry to track compatibility issues in production

5. Create version-specific implementations:
   - Develop VersionHandler interface with specific implementations for 1.21.7
   - Implement factory pattern to create appropriate handlers based on server version
   - Isolate version-specific code to improve maintainability
   - Document API changes between versions for future reference

6. Test compatibility across multiple environments:
   - Set up test servers with different Minecraft versions
   - Create automated tests for packet handling
   - Implement stress tests to verify stability under load
   - Document all compatibility issues and solutions
